points: Distance-7 color code on 73 physical qubits: about 5 logical errors per million syndrome cycles
Error suppression factor of about 12 per distance step (d=3 to d=7)
Logical two-qubit Clifford error about 7x10^-5 at d=5, versus about 9.5x10^-4 unencoded
read: Quantinuum preprint 'Quantum Error Correction Well Below the Color Code Threshold' (PDF)
take: Quantinuum claims logical errors fall more than tenfold per code-distance step, a key test for fault tolerance by 2029. Unreviewed preprint.
title: Quantinuum: color-code memory on Helios runs well below threshold
